title: Atomic variadic dependency add
description:
A variadic dependency add that fails per-edge validation partially commits: adding two edges where the second is redundant applies the first edge, then exits nonzero. This contradicts the all-or-nothing behavior of batch issue creation and leaves callers unable to trust the exit code as a no-op signal. Confirmed live during the epic fix audit.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: A variadic dependency add that fails validation for any edge leaves the dependency set unchanged.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: The error names every rejected edge, not only the first.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: The event log reflects only edges that were actually applied.
